protocol: Frozen final evaluation protocol: one-time test evaluation of the reference model
status: FROZEN — test split NOT evaluated; no test inference has been run

rules: no architecture, hyperparameter or checkpoint changes
1_frozen_model.why_seed_42: baseline_cnn_v3 (seed 42) was the reference run selected during the baseline optimization study, before the multi-seed study. The seed study (seeds 42/1337/2026) verified that architecture differences did not exceed seed noise and recommended baseline_cnn under its predeclared rule; it was used to check stability, not to pick the best seed. Seeds 1337 and 2026 are not evaluated on test.
1_frozen_model.code_compatibility: the checkpoint predates the config 'model' field; train.build_model treats its absence as baseline_cnn. Current inference code reproduces the recorded validation predictions exactly (reports/robustness/noise_robustness/clean_check.json).

patient_split.method: patient-balanced, seed 42 (src/data/create_splits.py); no patient in two splits

normalization.fitted_on: train patients only (88), per-mel-band mean/std in dB

audio_preprocessing.read: soundfile, float32 in [-1, 1]; multi-channel averaged to mono
audio_preprocessing.cycle_slice: [cycle_start_s, cycle_end_s) at the original sample rate; end up to 0.01 s past the file is clipped
audio_preprocessing.leading_zero_trimming: leading samples exactly 0.0 removed, capped at 0.15 s, at least one sample kept; applied to every cycle on every device
audio_preprocessing.no: padding, cropping, amplitude normalization or augmentation

logmel.details: DC removal (subtract waveform mean); Hann window; center=True with zero padding; power 2; HTK mel scale; no filter-area normalization; 10*log10(max(power, floor))

2_frozen_data_pipeline.model_input: train-band standardization with the frozen statistics; batches padded with 0 and a valid-frame mask; sequential (unshuffled) evaluation loader, batch size 32, num_workers 0

quality_metadata.measured_on: the annotated cycle at its original sample rate, before trimming and resampling

2_frozen_data_pipeline.determinism: train.set_determinism(0): cuDNN deterministic, benchmark off, deterministic algorithms (warn_only), CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
2_frozen_data_pipeline.rule: nothing in this pipeline may change after the test evaluation

3_primary_endpoint.primary_metric: macro F1 over the 4 classes on all test cycles (classification_metrics.classification_report; zero division gives 0)

confidence_intervals.rng: Python random.Random(seed); each resample draws len(patients) patient ids with replacement (rng.choice over sorted patient ids) and includes all cycles of each draw
confidence_intervals.interval: percentile: sorted values at indices int(0.025 n) and int(0.975 n) - 1
confidence_intervals.paired: the same patient draws are used for every method/condition being compared

3_primary_endpoint.rule: the primary metric will not change after viewing test results

4_quality_sensitivity_groups.fixed: README, 2026-10-03, before any model was trained (respiratory_dataset.in_quality_group)
metrics_per_group: macro F1 over classes present in the group (analyze_run.group_metrics convention)
balanced accuracy (4 classes and classes present)
patient-bootstrap 95% interval of macro F1 (resampling the group's patients)
4_quality_sensitivity_groups.role: sensitivity analyses; groups filter test cycles, they never change the split

5_calibration.application: p_T = softmax(logits / T), applied once; T is never fitted or modified on test data
report_for: probabilities scaled with the frozen T

metrics.nll: mean over cycles of -ln p_label (natural log)
metrics.brier: mean over cycles of sum_k (p_k - 1[label = k])^2; range 0-2
metrics.ece: top-label ECE, 15 equal-width confidence bins on [0, 1]; cycle with confidence c goes to bin index min(14, max(0, ceil(15 c) - 1)), i.e. bins [0, 1/15], (1/15, 2/15], ..., (14/15, 1]; ECE = sum_b (n_b / N) |acc_b - conf_b|, acc_b = fraction correct and conf_b = mean confidence in bin b; empty bins contribute 0
metrics.reliability_diagram: same 15 equal-width bins: per-bin accuracy vs mean confidence with bin counts, plus the diagonal

secondary_metrics_same_definitions_as_va: equal-mass top-label ECE: cycles sorted by confidence (ties by file order) and split into 15 contiguous groups whose sizes differ by at most 1
classwise ECE: for each class k, 15 equal-width bins on p_k with |observed frequency of class k - mean p_k| weighted by bin share; averaged over the 4 classes
MCE: largest |acc_b - conf_b| over non-empty equal-width bins
5_calibration.statement: temperature scaling cannot change any predicted class (T > 0 preserves the argmax), so accuracy, macro F1 and the confusion matrix are identical for raw and scaled probabilities

secondary: 1 - top-2 margin (predeclared in the validation plan)

metrics: AUPRC (average precision; tied scores one threshold)
test error rate as the AUPRC chance reference
6_uncertainty_error_detection.rule: no new uncertainty score will be introduced after seeing test results

ranking.primary: raw MSP, most confident first, stable tie-break by file order

7_selective_prediction.primary_analysis: selective risk (error rate among retained) and the risk-coverage curve; AURC and E-AURC
secondary_metrics: retained / rejected counts by true class and by predicted class
7_selective_prediction.zero_division: project-wide convention (classification_metrics._safe_div): any ratio with a zero denominator is 0, so a class with no retained true cycles has recall 0 and a class never predicted has precision 0, both giving F1 0; such a class still counts in the 4-class macro F1 and balanced accuracy and its zero support is shown in the retained counts (as in the validation plan, clarification 3)

frozen_validation_thresholds.definition: raw MSP of the last retained clean-validation cycle at 80% / 50% coverage; applied unchanged to test (retain if MSP >= tau)
report: confidently wrong share (wrong and MSP >= tau_50)

7_selective_prediction.rule: no threshold will be chosen using test performance

8_robustness.primary_final_test_evaluation: untouched clean test audio through the frozen pipeline
8_robustness.secondary_predeclared_robustness_evaluat: the 15 frozen conditions below applied to test audio ONLY after the clean test outputs are written and locked

definitions.applied_to: 16 kHz cycle waveform after frozen trimming/resampling, before frozen Log-Mel (PRIMARY_CONFIG, 50-2000 Hz) and frozen train-band normalization
definitions.gaussian_noise: white Gaussian, full 0-8 kHz band; SNR from DC-free mean-square powers; noise mean-removed and rescaled so the realized SNR is exact
definitions.lowpass: Blackman-windowed sinc FIR, 1025 taps, unit DC gain, centered (zero phase), cutoff = -6 dB point
definitions.temporal_dropout: 20 ms blocks; round-half-up(fraction x n_blocks) random blocks set to 0
definitions.randomness: torch.Generator per cycle, seed = sha256(base_seed|family|recording|cycle_index), base_seed 42; shared within a family

8_robustness.lock: clean test predictions, logits and metrics are written to disk and their SHA-256 hashes recorded in a lock file before any degraded test inference starts; the degraded run's 'clean' condition must reproduce the locked clean predictions exactly
reported: per condition: macro F1, balanced accuracy, accuracy, per-class F1, confusion matrix, absolute and relative macro-F1 change vs clean test, patient-bootstrap interval of the change, share of predictions changed
uncertainty under shift: mean MSP, entropy, overconfidence gap, ECE, NLL, error-detection AUROC, raw and frozen-T scaled; tau_80/tau_50 coverage, risk and confidently wrong share
8_robustness.rule: degradation parameters, seeds and conditions will not change after seeing test performance

bootstrap.rng: Python random.Random(seed); each resample draws len(patients) patient ids with replacement (rng.choice over sorted patient ids) and includes all cycles of each draw
bootstrap.interval: percentile: sorted values at indices int(0.025 n) and int(0.975 n) - 1
bootstrap.paired: the same patient draws are used for every method/condition being compared

rules: patient-level resampling only; cycles of one patient are never treated as independent
no significance fishing, no post-test model selection, no re-running with changed settings
predeclared analyses and any later exploratory observations are reported in separate, labelled sections
with 19 test patients intervals are wide; results are estimates with uncertainty, not significance claims

10_test_access_audit.checkpoint_contains: model_state, config, epoch, val_metrics (validation only), class_names, data_sha256

audio.method: sha256 over lines '<filename>\t<sha256 of file bytes>\n' for all .wav files sorted by name; integrity only, no audio decoded, no split-specific selection

12_unlock_procedure: Commit this protocol, src/evaluation/final_evaluation.py and its tests; the working tree must be clean (the test stages refuse to run otherwise) and the commit is recorded in every test output.
Run `python src/evaluation/final_protocol.py --verify`; abort if any content identity differs.
Run `python src/evaluation/final_evaluation.py dry-run-validation` (VALIDATION only): it must reproduce reports/runs/baseline_cnn_v3/val_predictions.csv and run.json's validation metrics exactly.

Unlock once: `python src/evaluation/final_evaluation.py clean-test --unlock-test UNLOCK-ONE-TIME-TEST-EVALUATION-baseline_cnn_v3`. It verifies everything again, writes a STARTED marker, loads the test split once, saves per-cycle logits/probabilities/predictions, computes sections 3-7, and writes clean_test/lock.json with the SHA-256 of every clean output.

Only then: `python src/evaluation/final_evaluation.py robustness-test --unlock-test UNLOCK-ONE-TIME-TEST-EVALUATION-baseline_cnn_v3`. It refuses unless the clean lock verifies, first reproduces the locked clean predictions through its own clean condition, then runs the 15 frozen conditions with the frozen T and thresholds (section 8).

Write the final report with predeclared results first and any exploratory observations separately. Any bug found after unlock is documented; original outputs are preserved, never silently replaced, and no stage is re-run because a result looks surprising (STARTED markers block re-runs).

stages.verify: Stage A: protocol manifest, checkpoint/data hashes, frozen values, provenance
stages.dry-run-validation: Stage B: exact clean inference path on VALIDATION; must reproduce the frozen reference
stages.clean-test: Stages A + C + D: one-time clean test evaluation and its lock
stages.robustness-test: Stage E: fixed degradations on test, only after the clean lock verifies

13_final_evaluator.default_behaviour: no stage runs without an explicit subcommand; test stages additionally require the exact unlock token and a clean Git working tree; validation is the only split the dry run can read
13_final_evaluator.no_test_time_choices: the temperature, thresholds, coverages, conditions, metrics, checkpoint and bootstrap settings come only from this protocol; the CLI has no flags for them; nothing is trained, fitted or selected on test data

outputs.clean_test: reports/final_evaluation/clean_test/ (STARTED.json, predictions.csv, metrics.json, summary.md, reliability_diagram.svg, risk_coverage_curves.csv, lock.json)

supersedes.changes: added src/evaluation/final_evaluation.py and its tests to the frozen inference system and manifest (section 13, updated unlock procedure with exact commands); --verify now uses LF-normalized Git blob ids as the content identity for text files and exact SHA-256 for ignored/binary artifacts; calibration_report.reliability_svg gained optional panels/title (validation output byte-identical); clarified zero-division wording. No frozen value, metric, threshold, temperature, condition or data artifact changed.
